name: Knote
description_en:
Knote is a product in the Note taking category. Its directory profile covers Recurring Tasks, Share Link, Calendar Notification, File Sharing, Real-time Collaboration, Task Tracking, Meetings.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: make files available to authorized participants. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
